calls.reconciliation: The runs shared the same evidence base (Q3 guide $13.0B +/-0.3B, 8/8 midpoint beats, consensus ~$12.97-13.19B, report Nov 3). Factual items: report date Nov 3 vs Oct 29 scheduled resolution affects timing only, not the value; consensus spread across providers is a provider difference, and MarketBeat's ~$12.4B is stale (below the guide range). The pre-2026 beat figures are unverified background knowledge, and I could not check them without web access, so I carry that uncertainty in the width. The only real disagreement is judgment: the size of the beat. The mean beat (4.2%) implies ~$13.55B, while the shrinking recent beats (6.3%, 7.0%, 4.6%, 3.0%) point to ~$13.39B. I put the median at $13.45B (~3.5%). I agree with the runs' dispersion (~$0.72-0.83B) and keep a 1% upper escape.
